title: Home chat: the Lead's report keeps its lines, and the understanding team's card leaves a built project's chat
request: Fix the two Home page issues the UI live check found: the report shown as one paragraph, and 'The team / Walk with the team' under a built project's chat.
spec: Two display fixes in dclab_rnd/agentic/web/src/views/home.html, the file another session also edits, committed alone.
plan: Draw a Lead card's text with its line breaks.
Hide the understanding team's panel when the draft has a project.
Rebuild the web app, check both kinds of chat in the browser.
Commit only these lines, built from HEAD in a temporary worktree.

decisions.decision: Hide the team panel on a built draft rather than remove it
decisions.why: the walk ends at the build; on a draft not yet built it still walks the person to the build

decisions.decision: Commit through a temporary worktree at HEAD with only this patch, then move main to that commit
decisions.why: home.html holds another session's uncommitted edits; never stash, never commit another session's work

change: dclab_rnd/agentic/web/src/views/home.html (loadTeam hides #home-team on a built draft; a Lead card's text keeps its lines); dclab_rnd/agentic/static/app/js/views/home.js (built).

findings.defect: The Lead's report showed its four lines as one paragraph
findings.scenario: UI live check: found, why, next and changed ran together
findings.cause:
a text message is drawn as one

without white-space:pre-line
findings.fix: a Lead card keeps its lines
findings.test: the browser check (white-space pre-line, four lines)

findings.defect: The understanding team's card stayed under a built project's chat
findings.scenario: UI live check: 'Walk with the team' under the Lead conversation
findings.cause: showDraftPanels shows the panel for every draft
findings.fix: loadTeam hides it when the draft has a project
findings.test: the browser check: hidden on the built chat, shown on a new unbuilt draft

measurements.name: browser check of both fixes
measurements.gate: the report in four lines; the team card hidden on a built chat and shown on an unbuilt one

outcome: The report reads as four lines and a built project's chat no longer offers a walk it cannot take.
lessons: When a file holds another session's uncommitted edits, build and commit the change from a worktree at HEAD with only your patch.
risks: A report saved before the id fix still shows its revision id; new reports do not.
No unit test covers the page: the browser check and make browser-test do.
